categories.main_business_segments: Ropeok Technology Group Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the AI technology sector, providing AI-enabled digital economy solutions and products. Its main business segments include AI+Public Safety, AI+Social Governance, AI+Transportation, AI+Cultural Tourism, AI+Education, AI+Healthcare and Elderly Care, AI+Urban Emergency, AI+Digital Ocean, AI+Agricultural Ecology, and AI+Industrial Manufacturing. The company offers integrated software and hardware products, system solutions, and data services across these sectors.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages core AI technologies including computer vision, multi-modal data perception, edge computing, big data analytics, semantic analysis, machine learning, and intelligent integration. It has developed an AI unified platform (RUP) and AIoT technology platform, integrating AI large models, IoT, and big data. Manufacturing involves embedded systems, intelligent hardware platforms, and software development with a focus on modular, low-code AI platforms and edge AI deployment. The company also emphasizes proprietary algorithms, multi-modal large models, and AIoT integration for product innovation.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Ropeok serves primarily government agencies such as public security bureaus, judicial and law enforcement bodies, transportation authorities, education and healthcare institutions, and enterprises in industrial manufacturing, agriculture, and marine sectors. Its solutions target public safety, social governance, smart city management, digital ocean economy, cultural tourism, and industrial digital transformation. The company’s customers are mainly in sectors requiring AI-enabled digital transformation and intelligent management.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively across China with regional subsidiaries and research institutes in cities including Xiamen, Shanghai, Chongqing, Qingdao, and others. It has a nationwide presence with a focus on regional and county-level markets, and is exploring overseas markets with preparations for international business expansion. Key geographic segments include East China, South China, Central China, Northeast, North China, Southwest, and Northwest regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: Ropeok operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the AI technology supply chain. It develops core AI algorithms, software platforms, and intelligent hardware products, and provides integrated system solutions and services to end customers. The company also engages in data services and AI application deployment, positioning itself as a technology provider and solution integrator rather than a raw material supplier or pure hardware manufacturer.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on deepening AI core technology development in computing power, algorithms, and data. It prioritizes R&D in multi-modal large models, AIoT platforms, edge computing, and data governance with privacy and security. Ropeok emphasizes industry-specific AI applications, collaborative innovation with academic and research institutions, and rapid commercialization of research outcomes. It also invests in building a sustainable AI ecosystem through partnerships and expanding AI+ industry integration.
categories.revenue_model: Ropeok generates revenue mainly through sales of AI-enabled system solutions, intelligent hardware products, and maintenance and other related services. Revenue is recognized upon delivery and acceptance of products or over time for service contracts. The company also earns income from government subsidies, investment returns, and licensing of technology. Its business model includes direct sales, project-based contracts, and ongoing service agreements.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes in the AI and digital economy sectors, focusing on AI+ industry applications. It holds a recognized position as a national specialized and innovative 'little giant' enterprise with strong R&D capabilities and extensive industry experience. Competitors include domestic AI technology firms and integrators in public safety, smart city, and industrial AI solutions. Ropeok differentiates itself through its integrated AI technology platform, multi-sector application expertise, and strong government and institutional client base.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Ropeok reported total revenue of approximately RMB 142.96 million, a 68% decrease from the previous year, with a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 193.23 million. Total assets stood at RMB 1.52 billion, down 20% year-over-year. The company has experienced revenue volatility due to project delays and market conditions but continues to invest heavily in R&D, with R&D expenses accounting for nearly 20% of revenue. It maintains a stable asset base and is focused on sustainable growth through technology innovation and market expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Ropeok emphasizes its unique value proposition of delivering AI technology solutions that bridge the gap from core technology to practical industry applications, especially in public safety and smart city domains. Its competitive differentiation lies in its integrated AI platform, proprietary multi-modal large models, edge computing capabilities, and comprehensive data governance with security and privacy compliance. The company’s deep industry knowledge, collaborative R&D ecosystem, and ability to customize solutions for diverse sectors enable it to provide high-value, reliable, and scalable AI products and services.
